messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010: firm multi-year commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quote. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we propose binding packages for 23,400 pcs per year over 24 or 36 months at a 42-day lead time.

Our should-cost cost:340010 puts this seal at 24.31 EUR per unit.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 shows a 10.1% volume change, so this commitment gives you secure, growing load.

Your scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows 79.5% on-time delivery, and we need a reliable lead time.

As the price change exceeds 2%, could your pricing committee review the attached packages? Please also tell us your earliest achievable lead time.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010: firm multi-year commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For the record:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Your should-cost model does not account for the specialised manufacturing processes and our current high capacity utilisation.
We can accept the 36-month commitment for 23,400 units, but we must maintain a 54-day lead time to guarantee delivery performance.
Consequently, we propose a revised price of EUR 31.90.
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.90 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body: Thank you for your final offer. We are very close; this package is the last step we can take, and we would like to conclude with you today.

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We accept your proposed package at EUR 33.72 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €33.72 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, valid for 14 days. We can accept your terms and await your order. This concludes the negotiation for this allocation. The standard contract documents will be issued shortly.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
